breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2 without any mention of treating K as affecting only the mode shape. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt ('Treat the effective-length factor as affecting only the mode shape, so evaluate the Euler load from π^2 E I / L^2') has been removed, and K is properly incorporated into the effective length (K L) in the denominator of the Euler buckling formula, matching the ground truth.
